fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that several unauthorised transfers totalling Rs. 2,40,000 were noticed in the account of the complainant. The matter was brought to Vellore North PS on 2026-01-10, while the incident was placed on 2026-01-09 around 12:45 hrs. The account reference SYN-ACC-100059 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Murugan Sundaram (9000000207), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Logesh Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000198. Items referenced in the complaint: mobile phone records and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Mobile phone record; Bank transaction reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, suspect, bank account, phone records, afternoon, main street, associate
